description: This PHP source file defines the Immigration display field class used within the OrangeHRM system's reporting module. It extends a listable display field and specifies the DTO class, entity alias, and relevant fields for immigration records related to employees.

classes.name: Immigration
classes.description: A class representing the Immigration display field in reports, extending ListableDisplayField to provide specific immigration-related data for reporting.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field, which is Dto\Immigration.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Provides the entity alias for querying, which is 'immigrationRecord'.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns the fields used in queries; in this case, 'employee.empNumber'.
